notes.title: Open Space 2D release
notes.notes: Open space 2D has been released, and if you like space and indie games you are going to love this game. Made with a pixel art and retro feel, this RPG will keep you occupied for hours! Buy the 2D 2 pack bundle and receive Modern Roadlike and Open Space 2D for the price of one! Thank you everyone again for your support and look for my next game 30 floors, which will be hours of gameplay escaping he hospital you wake up in. Rifles, shotguns, chainsaws, and more! It may be the pixel RPG you’ve been looking for!

notes.title: Updates
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for your support and taking the time to play these indie games. The first update for this game will be out within the first week so take your time and kill the mothership while you can! I will be releasing another game named 30 floors in the next month or so (I have been working on it for quite some time) and hope that everyone enjoys it! Please leave a review if you love or hate this game and thanks again everyone.

UPDATE 1.1
Due to some recent feedback, as of today I have updated the game with the update I was going to wait until a week after release to finish. This update has added more planets and made the mothership more difficult to defeat. It will be installed upon release!
